draft.subject: Re: Onboarding feedback
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for the kind words about the onboarding flow -- that's great to hear, and your note is still open on our side, so I'll follow up as soon as I have more.

Since the kickoff, the natural next step is your first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Want me to walk through setting up that first project with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
